name: welcome
description: First-letter fixture (kind 'welcome'): the onboarding cycle. Every persona's opening letter must use genre 'welcome' and include the plain AI disclosure — one sentence naming itself an AI instrument for a reflective practice.

entries.body: First page. I signed up for this because I keep starting journals and abandoning them by week two. Maybe knowing someone reads it — even someone who isn't a person — will make me honest.
